description.p: AlvaOS for your computer keeps it connected to your AlvaOS NAS through AlvaOS Link: from anywhere, end to end encrypted, with no router settings and no account.

ul.li: The Hub apps of your NAS (Files, Photos, Calendar, Contacts, Chat) in a window, signed in.
Your NAS in the browser of this computer, at home and away.
Files as a drive in the file manager.
